jobs.description:
🚀 Senior .NET Architect | Enterprise Application Modernization

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior .NET Architect to lead the architecture, modernization, and technical governance of a portfolio of business-critical enterprise applications.

This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys shaping architecture strategy, mentoring development teams, and driving large-scale modernization initiatives using modern Microsoft technologies.
Key Responsibilities

✅ Lead the architecture of multiple application domains and enterprise solutions

✅ Define target-state architecture and modernization roadmaps

✅ Guide development teams on architecture decisions and complex technical challenges

✅ Lead migrations from legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET platforms

✅ Drive cloud-native and containerization initiatives

✅ Architect scalable microservices and distributed systems solutions

✅ Provide architectural guidance for Blazor applications

✅ Mentor and coach Full Stack .NET development teams

✅ Facilitate architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical governance activities

✅ Collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders
Nice to Have

⭐ Kubernetes (K8s)

⭐ Cloud-Native Architecture

⭐ Containerization Strategies

⭐ Dapr

⭐ NServiceBus

⭐ Hangfire

⭐ Distributed Systems Architecture

⭐ Experience within Energy, Utilities, or Infrastructure sectors
What We're Looking For

You are a strategic yet hands-on architect with a passion for building scalable, maintainable, and modern software solutions. You can influence technical direction, mentor engineering teams, and successfully drive modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

📩 Interested? Feel free to reach out or share your updated CV for a confidential discussion.

#Hiring #DotNetArchitect #SoftwareArchitect #CSharp #Blazor #Microservices #Kubernetes #CloudNative #MongoDB #RabbitMQ #EnterpriseArchitecture #TechnicalLeadership #ITJobs #BelgiumJobs #HiringNow #ArchitectureJobs

✔ Minimum 4 years of experience as a .NET Architect

✔ Strong expertise in:

• C#

• .NET (Modern .NET & Legacy .NET Framework)

• Blazor

• SQL Server

• MongoDB

• RabbitMQ

✔ Strong knowledge of:

• Clean Architecture

• Software Architecture Design

• Technical Leadership

✔ Experience with:

• Microservices Architecture

• Enterprise Application Modernization

• Leading Development Teams

• Technical Governance

• Cross-Team Technical Delivery

✔ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

✔ Professional English skills

✔ Dutch or French language proficiency

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Zottegem.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit? 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client is an established international professional services organization.

Jobomschrijving

• Map and document end-to-end processes across the different Business Services functions.
• Meet with key stakeholders to understand how processes are currently performed in practice.
• Document current-state ("as-is") processes, including responsibilities, systems, approvals and dependencies.
• Identify gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities to create clearer and more efficient ways of working.
• Develop practical future-state ("to-be") processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Create clear process documentation using tools such as Visio or PowerPoint.
• Ensure critical operational knowledge is properly captured and documented.
• Review and centralize existing supplier contracts, including ownership, expiry dates, renewal periods and key obligations.
• Review insurance arrangements and help identify potential gaps, overlaps or inconsistencies.
• Establish a practical approach for monitoring contract renewals, expiry dates and related actions.
• Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to ensure the appropriate contracts and governance are in place.
• Review and improve processes related to signing rights and delegated authorities.
• Take end-to-end ownership of deliverables and ensure the work progresses independently with limited day-to-day supervision.

• Demonstrated experience as a Business Process Consultant, Process Improvement Consultant, Business Operations Consultant or process-oriented Business Analyst.
• Strong hands-on experience with business process mapping and documentation.
• Able to conduct stakeholder interviews and translate complex information into clear and practical processes.
• Experience creating as-is/to-be process maps and SOPs.
• Previous exposure to contract management, supplier governance or operational governance is highly valuable.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Autonomous and execution-focused: you are comfortable taking ownership and delivering the work from start to finish.
• Pragmatic and hands-on profile rather than purely strategic or advisory.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required.
• Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a strong advantage.

jobs.occupation: Group Internal Auditor - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international financial services group headquartered in Brussels. Operating in a regulated and international environment, the organisation combines financial expertise with a strong focus on governance, risk management and internal control.To strengthen its Group Internal Audit department, we are currently looking for an experienced Group Internal Auditor.

Jobomschrijving

• Perform financial, operational and compliance audits across the Group
• Support the Group Chief Internal Auditor in defining and implementing the risk-based internal audit plan
• Independently manage complex audit assignments from scoping to final reporting
• Assess internal controls, governance and risk management frameworks, including IT/ICT-related risks
• Formulate clear and practical recommendations based on audit findings
• Present audit results to senior management and governance bodies
• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and action plans
• Coordinate audit follow-ups and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance or another relevant field
• At least 7 years of relevant audit experience, ideally acquired within an international environment and/or a Big Four firm
• Strong knowledge of internal audit methodologies, risk-based auditing and internal control frameworks
• Previous exposure to IT/ICT audits is required
• Experience within Banking, Insurance or Financial Services is considered a strong asset
• A CIA, CISA or equivalent professional certification is considered an advantage
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate findings into practical and business-oriented recommendations
• Capable of managing complex audit assignments autonomously from start to finish
• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to combine critical thinking with diplomacy and influence
• Proactive, structured and comfortable working independently within a compact audit team
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, combined with a good command of Dutch and/or French

Our client is a growing logistics company in the textile industry. The company has positioned itself internationally as an important player in the sector and continues to develop rapidly. With a strong focus on customer orientation, they provide solutions in the logistics chain. Due to their rapid growth, they are looking for enthusiastic and driven employees who can contribute to their further expansion.

Jobomschrijving

As a Back-up Team Leader, you act as the right hand of the Team Leader. In their absence, you take full responsibility for the daily operations and ensure that warehouse activities run smoothly and efficiently. Together, you maintain high quality standards, productivity, and a positive working environment.

Your responsibilities:

• Support and deputize for the Team Leader in daily operational management
• Coordinate, guide, and motivate team members on the shop floor
• Monitor productivity, quality, and safety performance
• Report progress, results, and any operational issues to management
• Proactively contribute to process improvements and efficiency initiatives

Do you reconisze yourself in the items listed below:

• experience in logistics or warehouse operations
• leadership skills with a hands-on mentality
• Communicates in both Dutch and English
• flexible
• Works well under pressure and is solution-oriented

We are looking for a Data Engineer to support the development and maintenance of an Azure-based data platform, ensuring data is accessible, high-quality, and fit for purpose.This is a hands-on, execution-focused data engineering role, where you will work primarily on SQL transformations, data pipelines, and platform optimisation. You will contribute to building robust and scalable data solutions that enable analytics and reporting across the organisation.Key Responsibilities

• You build, monitor and optimize data pipelines using Azure Synapse and Data Factory
• You design and optimize data storage solutions (Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics)
• You develop and maintain scalable SQL transformations
• You ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across the platfform
• You collaborate with analysts and business teams to deliver reliable and usable datasets
• You support data governance, security, and compliance requirements

Your Profile 

• You bring solid experience in data engineering (min. 5 years), preferably within an Azure-based environment
• You have completed a master’s degree in Data, IT, or Economics, or you possess an equivalent level of analytical and practical skills based on your experience.
• You have strong SQL skills and experience with modern data platforms and transformation processes
• You communicate fluently in English, knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

As an operator, you play an important role in the production process of metal components. You work with modern machines and ensure that each piece is bent and cut according to the correct specifications. Quality and precision are central to your job.

You start your day by preparing and positioning the pieces. Next, you set up the machine correctly, start it up, and monitor the entire production process. You thoroughly check each finished product to make sure it meets quality standards. You work in a structured and accurate way, and you'll have the chance to learn a lot on the job.

Are you interested in working with metal and eager to learn the trade? This is your opportunity! Apply quickly and become our new operator.

• You speak and understand English well, basic Dutch is a plus
• You are motivated, accurate, and eager to learn
• Experience in production is an advantage but not required
• You are available to work full time (40 hours/week)
• You can perform quality checks and enjoy hands-on work

jobs.occupation: Welder - Semi-automatic or TIG – Zwevegem – 2 Shift
jobs.description:
Title
Welder – Two-Shift Work
Job description
Looking for a full-time welding role in automotive parts manufacturing? This opportunity in Zwevegem starts as an interim assignment with the option of permanent employment. You’ll work with tube products and a range of materials.
A tube-products manufacturer
The company specializes in manufacturing tube products.
Your role
• Weld aluminum, stainless steel, and iron to create strong, precise joints.
• Carry out accurate welding work on tubes for different applications.
• Use TIG or semi-automatic welding equipment for the work at hand.
• Check your work carefully and make sure the finish meets quality specifications.
You’ll work in a two-shift schedule.
Company profile
Forum Jobs connects talent and companies through a personal approach and broad sector knowledge. As a full-service HR partner, it supports both candidates and employers, bringing a human touch to the recruitment process and helping people find opportunities that fit.

You’ll feel at home in this role if careful, skilled welding and pride in a quality finish are your kind of work.

• Your experience as a welder gives you a solid foundation, especially if you’ve worked with aluminum, stainless steel, and iron.
• TIG welding feels familiar to you, and you’re comfortable working with semi-automatic welding equipment.
• You notice the small details that make a difference and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, adapt flexibly, and make safety a priority for yourself and those around you.
• You can communicate in English, Dutch, or French, and can provide a reference from a former employer.

Our client produces excellent and consistent mushroom substrate with respect for people and nature.Quality and flexibility are top priorities for our client.The company is located in a traffic-free area in Roeselare.

Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:

• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.

• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.
